name: Zonju V
description: Zonju V was a planet in the Wild Space, rimward of Rutan. Its terrain consisted of shallow, dusty, scrubby, sparsely-foliated canyons and gorges; littered with deserted ruins carved from sandstone rock. The capital city was Zoronhed.
lead_paragraphs: Zonju V was a planet in the Wild Space, rimward of Rutan. Its terrain consisted of shallow, dusty, scrubby, sparsely-foliated canyons and gorges; littered with deserted ruins carved from sandstone rock. The capital city was Zoronhed.
